name: TreeView
summary: Hierarchical node list. File tree, navigation tree, org chart. Each node has a chevron-disclosure, an icon, a label, and an optional badge. Selection is single-row; multi-selection lives in DataGrid. Lazy-loaded subtrees announce 'Loading children…' via aria-live.

expandedIds.description: Array of node ids currently expanded.

keyboard: ArrowDown - move focus to next visible node
ArrowRight - expand collapsed; if expanded, move to first child
ArrowLeft - collapse expanded; if collapsed, move to parent
rules: Root role='tree'; each node role='treeitem'; child wrapper role='group'.
aria-level reflects depth; aria-setsize + aria-posinset reflect siblings.
Lazy-loaded subtree: while pending, render a Skeleton row and aria-live='polite' announce.

do: Use a leading lucide icon per node (Folder, FileText, Hash, etc.).
Indent via padding-left = indent * level; don't use margin.
Allow keyboard ArrowRight/Left to walk the tree fully.
dont: Don't use TreeView for flat lists — that's List.
Don't render more than 1000 visible rows without virtualization.
Don't lime-fill selected row — use action.selected.bg.
